scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,frontend "npm run backend" "npm run frontend-dev"
scripts.frontend-dev: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.build: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,frontend "npm run backend" "npm run frontend-build"
scripts.frontend-build: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
